get_packed_grad_shard: get the interleaved shard of a packed gradient tensor for a given rank and world size
_init_distributed: decorate a test function to run it across multiple distributed processes using torch multiprocessing spawn
_load_tp_and_reference_models: load a tensor-parallel model and a non-TP reference model from the same checkpoint for comparison
test_tp_forward: test that a tensor-parallel model produces the same forward pass logits as a non-TP reference model
test_tp_backward: test that a tensor-parallel model produces matching gradients during backprop compared to a non-TP reference model
